judge.rationale: The implementation is a clean, direct realization of the requirements with no architectural slop. It uses a set union to enumerate all fields across both dicts, iterates once, builds explicit records with the required keys, and sorts by field name. The code is flat, readable, and locally auditable in a single glance. There are no abstractions, no helper classes, no unnecessary complexity, and no collapsed summaries — every changed field gets its own explicit record with field, before, and after exactly as specified.
